name: HORN-8 Point-Cloud Hologram Generation
definition: A hardware-accelerated method for generating computer-generated holograms (CGH) from point-cloud data using a dedicated FPGA pipeline. It uses a normalized Fresnel approximation to allow integer arithmetic and incremental phase calculation, avoiding memory look-up tables for cosine operations.
summary: HORN-8 is a hardware-accelerated FPGA method for generating point-cloud holograms using a memoryless pipeline that eliminates trigonometric look-up tables via integer arithmetic and incremental phase calculation.
